jql.created: project in (FILTER, AWARE, PRODUCT24, RESP, AICHAT, PASS, FLEX, COM, MDMCLASS, PAGESCAN, DD, DE, DEVOPS, HOME) AND issuetype in ("Escape Defect", "Support Request") AND "Zendesk Ticket Count" > 0 AND created >= "2026-07-01" ORDER BY created ASC
jql.created_open: project in (FILTER, AWARE, PRODUCT24, RESP, AICHAT, PASS, FLEX, COM, MDMCLASS, PAGESCAN, DD, DE, DEVOPS, HOME) AND issuetype in ("Escape Defect", "Support Request") AND "Zendesk Ticket Count" > 0 AND created >= "2026-07-01" AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY created ASC
jql.created_done: project in (FILTER, AWARE, PRODUCT24, RESP, AICHAT, PASS, FLEX, COM, MDMCLASS, PAGESCAN, DD, DE, DEVOPS, HOME) AND issuetype in ("Escape Defect", "Support Request") AND "Zendesk Ticket Count" > 0 AND created >= "2026-07-01" AND statusCategory = Done ORDER BY created ASC
